scope: AQA Year 1/AS Pure first school Maths mock; original v191 transformation question only
issue: The specialised marker omitted algebraically equivalent exact pairs of x-intercepts and gave marks for certain explicitly negated transformation descriptions.
limitations: This specifically calibrates one original question, not every algebraic equivalent, all exam questions or handwritten OCR.
Approximate decimal roots are not automatically awarded by these additions; a human can review equivalent valid answers.
Natural-language negation detection remains heuristic; students retain the ability to correct marks manually.
The full paper archive and requirement-by-requirement specification audit remain incomplete.
